description: This file defines an abstract class 'SavingsAccountBusinessEvent' that models a business event related to savings accounts within the Fineract project. It extends a generic 'AbstractBusinessEvent' and specifies the category and aggregate root ID for such events.

classes.name: SavingsAccountBusinessEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing business events related to SavingsAccount objects, providing category and ID retrieval methods.

methods.name: SavingsAccountBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a SavingsAccount object.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category string for this event type ('Savings').

methods.name: getAggregateRootId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated SavingsAccount.
